messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — SLO burn-rate jumped ~3x around 04:12 UTC after the deploy. Anyone point me to the best dashboards/traces to check whether KV cache misses or the model-variant switch caused it?

alex: Start with Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/serving/slo-overview?orgId=1 (panel: 'SLO burn by route'). APM traces: https://apm.redwood.company/traces?service=serving. Metric for KV misses is `serving_kv_cache_miss_total`.

alex: Prometheus queries that help:
```
sum(rate(serving_kv_cache_miss_total[5m])) by (route)
sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (route)
sum(rate(token_generation_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)
```

jamal: I saw the same spike — it aligns with the model-variant rollout at 04:10. I muted the noisy slo-burn-rate:/chat-route alert for 10m while we investigate. :hand:

li-chen: For tuning alerts: avoid raw burn thresholds that fire on short bursts. Two suggestions: 1) require `burn_rate > X` AND `for: 10m` 2) add secondary condition `kv_miss_rate > Y` if we believe cache behavior matters. I can open a PR with adjusted rules.

maya: Thanks. Can someone drop a direct panel link for per-route p95 latency and an example trace span to inspect? Also do we have a Datadog dashboard or just Grafana/APM?

alex: Panel (p95 per route): https://grafana.redwood.company/d/serving/latency?view=p95&panelId=7. Example APM trace: open a trace and filter by span name `model.generate`. We don't have Datadog for serving metrics (only infra).

jamal: Created INF-432 to track: "Investigate SLO spike post-deploy, evaluate cache impact, propose alert tuning" and linked the grafana + trace samples.

li-chen: Oncall: @li-chen I left some notes in INF-432 about rolling back the variant if error rate stays high. Also propose adding `serving_kv_cache_hit_ratio` to the SLO dashboard.

sre-bot: [automated] alert muted: `slo-burn-rate:/chat-route` by jamal until 04:22 UTC.

maya: I'll run a controlled traffic test against /chat-route with a small prompt set and post results here. If anyone sees sustained 5xx after 04:22 ping me and I'll roll the variant back. :thumbsup:
